title: Back for More! Buzznerd Returns to Karmak for a 4th Year
description: Our fourth consecutive appearance at the Karmak Conference & Expo — come find us on the floor.

props.text: Events · 1 min read · By Jerry Van Galder
Our fourth consecutive appearance at the Karmak Conference & Expo — St. Louis Union Station.

The countdown is on! We're thrilled to announce our fourth consecutive appearance at the renowned Karmak Conference & Expo. This year's event takes place at the historic St. Louis Union Station from October 1–3, 2024, and we wouldn't miss it for the world.

items.label: Address: 1820 Market Street, St. Louis, MO 63103

props.text: Our commitment to the Karmak community runs deep. Each year we're energized by the industry insights, the cutting-edge trends, and the chance to connect with the people who drive the trucking world forward. This fourth year marks a special milestone, underscoring our dedication to the Karmak ecosystem and the innovation it fosters.

props.text: Here's to another year of innovation, partnership, and pushing the boundaries of what's possible in the trucking industry. See you in St. Louis!
